dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: I put together a transportation plan for you! I figured you'd be better off walking or biking. It's cheaper, and you'll get more exercise!

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: But I need a car. I can't bike all the way to work at night…

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: I don't think we can even afford a car right now. You'll get used to it. Honestly, you could probably use the exercise anyway.

dialogue.speaker: orange
dialogue.text: You'll feel healthier once you're a little less… blob-y!

dialogue.speaker: purple
dialogue.text: I guess I could try it.

glossary.label: What is financial abuse?
glossary.body: Restricting a partner's access to independent money, transportation, or employment makes physical escape from a relationship nearly impossible. By framing isolation as "taking care of expenses," the abuser dismantles the victim's autonomy while keeping them entirely dependent.

steps.quote: Maybe you should take fewer hours at work, then.
I figured you'd be better off walking or biking.
I'll cover all our expenses anyway.

glossary.note: Without a job or a car, Violet now has to rely on Mango for money and for getting around.
